description: Elves are a magical people of otherworldly grace, living in places of ethereal beauty, amidst ancient forests or in silvery spires.

features.name: Darkvision
features.tldr: You have superior vision in dark and dim conditions, seeing in dim light as if it were bright light, and darkness as if it were dim light.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.tldr: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

features.name: Trance
features.tldr: Elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day.

features.name: Elven Subrace
features.tldr: Choose a subrace to reflect your upbringing, such as High Elf or Wood Elf.

features.name: Elven Lineage Magic
features.tldr: Depending on your subrace choice, you unlock innate spellcasting or expanded environmental movement options.

features.name: Step of the Ancients
features.tldr: You gain the ability to cast *Pass Without Trace* or a similar innate magical ward once per long rest without expending spell slots.
